bullets: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md: document the CS0104 Windows.Web.Http vs System.Net.Http ambiguity (ImplicitUsings root cause + CS0535/WMC9999 cascade + three fixes) — recurs for any UWP app using the Windows.Web.Http/AdaptiveMediaSource/IHttpFilter stack.
